description: Three clock dividers with divisions of 1 to 99 that stay in step with each other while the division is changed

params.text: Sets the division for its output, 1 to 99

inputs.text: Each rising edge advances the count all three dividers work from
A rising edge sets the count to zero, so all three dividers start again together
Sets the division for that output, 0.1V per division over 0-10V, and overrides the division selector while patched

outputs.text: Passes the clock through on every division-th count, keeping the pulse width of the incoming clock

menu: Keep input clock original pulse width — passes the incoming pulse through; turned off, each output is a square wave that is high for as many clock edges as the division and then low for as many
Round division input — rounds the voltage at a division input to the nearest division in place of truncating it

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
